description: Apple on Tuesday refreshed the Mac Studio and Mac mini in India. The update brings the Cupertino-based tech giant’s latest-generation silicon to the compact desktop lineup. The updated Mac Studio now comes with M5 Max and the new M5 Ultra chips. Meanwhile, the Mac mini can be configured with both the M5 Pro as well as the new M6 silicon. Apple claiming significant gains over their predecessors in terms of on-device AI performance, while the new models also support Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6.
title: Apple Refreshes Mac Studio With M5 Max, M5 Ultra Chips; Mac Mini Gets M6 Upgrade: Price, Specifications

description: The CMF Buds Neo prove that affordable earbuds don't have to feel like a compromise. They offer a comfortable fit, enjoyable sound and noise cancellation that works better than expected for the price. The experience is not flawless, with a few missing conveniences and some limitations at higher volumes, but the overall package is easy to live with. For budget-conscious listeners, the CMF Buds Neo can be a convincing everyday companion.
title: CMF Buds Neo Review: The Best Bang-for-Buck Earbuds Right Now

description: Apple has introduced its new M6 and M5 Ultra chipsets on its new Mac Mini (2026) and Mac Studio (2026). The new M6 is Apple’s first chipset fabricated using the 2nm process technology. It features a Dual 16-core Neural Engine, which is claimed to deliver up to 2x peak compute, compared to previous generations. The system framework of Apple’s M6 SoC is capable of automatically utilising both Neural Engines simultaneously for faster execution of AI models. On the other hand, the new Apple Silicon M5 Ultra SoC is the tech giant’s first chip to feature the new Quad-Die architecture.
title: Apple M6 Introduced as Firm’s First 2nm Chipset, Alongside M5 Ultra With a Quad-Die Architecture on 2026 Mac Mini, Studio

description: Block Bits Capital co-founder Japheth Dillman has been found guilty of wire fraud and conspiracy to commit wire fraud after prosecutors alleged that he and a co-conspirator misled more than 20 investors about an automated cryptocurrency trading system. The US Department of Justice said investors lost nearly $1 million. Dillman remains out on bond and is scheduled to be sentenced on December 8.
title: Block Bits Capital Founder Found Guilty in $1 Million Crypto Fraud Case

description: Monad researchers Kushal Babel and Jan Camenisch have proposed a new account design that separates a blockchain address from the credentials used to authorise transactions. The approach could allow users to rotate lost or outdated keys, use passkeys and enable social recovery without moving their assets to a new address. The design could also support multisignature access and future post-quantum authentication.
title: Monad Proposes New Wallet Design Focused on Passkeys and Quantum Security

description: Discord has said it has not yet been served with subpoena from Take-Two, which has made legal requests from the company to release user account information. The Rockstar Games parent has filed subpoenas in a US court seeking information from companies like X, Microsoft and Discord after a string of GTA 6 leaks surfaced online.
title: Discord Says It Has Not Received Take-Two Subpoena Over GTA 6 Leaks as More Gameplay Clips Surface Online

description: The new ChatGPT feature allows users to create sticker packs from text prompts or their own images. Each pack can contain up to nine stickers, with 18 visual styles available for customisation. Users can also combine stickers with emojis and use transparent backgrounds for a more natural sticker appearance. Once created, the packs can be downloaded or shared through iMessage and WhatsApp. OpenAI says the feature uses ChatGPT Images 2.0 and is available globally for free to users of the mobile ChatGPT app.
title: ChatGPT Gets New Sticker Maker for Personalised iMessage, WhatsApp Packs

description: Haier's new M70 series brings several picture processing tools, including AI HDR Enhancer, AI Colour Boost and AI Noise Reduction, alongside Mini LED and Micro Dimming technology. The TVs also offer a dedicated Gaming Bar with Shadow Enhancement and Crosshair Assist. Other features include HaiCast screen mirroring, Bluetooth Speaker Mode, 2GB RAM, 32GB storage and TÜV Rheinland-certified Low Blue Light technology. The range is available through leading retail outlets in India.
title: Haier Mini LED M70 Series Launched in India With Up to 85-Inch Screen, Dolby Vision Support: Price, Features

description: Asus has launched multiple new TUF series gaming laptops in India, the Taiwanese tech giant announced on Tuesday. The company has unveiled the new Asus TUF Gaming 16 (FX610), along with the Asus TUF Gaming A15 (FA506NCQ), Asus TUF Gaming A16 (FA608), Asus TUF Gaming F16 (FX607), and Asus TUF Gaming A15 (FA506NCG). The new Asus laptops are available for purchase in India via the Asus online store, Flipkart, Amazon, the Asus exclusive offline stores, and other offline retail channels.
title: Asus TUF Gaming 16 (FX610) Launched in India With Up to Nvidia GeForce RTX 5060 GPU, Alongside Refreshed TUF A15, A16 and F16

description: India is set to test its first tokenised corporate bond issuance, with state-backed power financier REC expected to issue bonds worth less than Rs. 5 billion using the digital rupee for settlement. The pilot, being conducted with the RBI and SEBI, will explore whether distributed ledger technology can make corporate bond issuance and settlement faster.
title: India Set to Launch First Tokenised Corporate Bonds With Digital Rupee

description: Sony Xperia 10 VIII has been launched in select global markets, the Japanese tech giant announced on Tuesday. The phone sports a 6.1-inch Full-HD+ (1,080 x 2,340 pixels) OLED display, offering up to a 120Hz refresh rate, a 120Hz touch sampling rate, 100 percent DCI-P3 colour gamut, a 19.5:9 aspect ratio, and Corning Gorilla Glass Victus 2 protection. Powering the Sony Xperia 10 VIII is an octa-core Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 chipset. The smartphone will be available for purchase in Frosted Gray, Frozen White, and Misty Lilac colour options. It will go on sale in select global markets later this year via the Sony online store.
title: Sony Xperia 10 VIII Launched With 50-Megapixel Rear Camera, Snapdragon 6 Gen 3 Chipset: Price, Specifications

description: Vivo announced the launch date of the upcoming Vivo T5 5G in India on Tuesday. The handset is expected to join the brand’s expansive T5 lineup, which already comprises the Vivo T5 Lite 5G, T5x 5G, and T5 Pro 5G. Ahead of its anticipated arrival, the brand has also teased several key features of the upcoming handset. It is confirmed to be equipped with a 1.5K 144Hz display and MediaTek Dimensity 7500 Turbo chipset. The Vivo T5 5G will be offered in two colourways and is teased to pack a 7,050mAh battery.
title: Vivo T5 5G India Launch Date Announced; Confirmed to Feature 144Hz Display, Dimensity 7500 Turbo Chip

description: In a sea of feature phones, HMD has announced yet another phone called the Nokia 300 Charge. The phone is a typical feature phone with a slightly ruggedised design, but packs a larger than usual 3,700mAh battery along with a torch light, which is plenty big for such a phone. Also included is a reverse charging feature.
title: Nokia 300 Charge Feature Phone Announced 3,700mAh Battery, Reverse Charging Support: Price, Specifications

description: The reported launch could give Googlebook a much broader starting point than ChromeOS had in 2011, when Google introduced the platform on just two laptops. The upcoming devices are expected to come from several established PC makers, with different chip architectures and designs catering to varied use cases. The reported hardware also points to Google's attempt to build the platform around more premium computing experiences from the beginning, rather than relying on basic reference machines and expanding the ecosystem gradually.
title: Googlebook Could Launch With Up to Eight Laptops From Lenovo, HP, Dell, Acer and Asus

description: Gamescom Opening Night Live returns on August 25, bringing a host of game annoncements, reveals, and world premieres. Host Geoff Keighley has alreayd confirmed some of the games that will be shown during the event. Here's what you can expect from the show.
title: Gamescom Opening Night Live 2026: How to Watch and What to Expect

description: Nothing OS 5.0 has been unveiled by the Carl Pei-led smartphone maker. The best version of the new Android 17-based user interface will start rolling out on August 26 (Wednesday) at 3:30 pm IST. The Nothing Phone (3) will be the first smartphone from the company to receive the beta version of the latest software, with the stable release planned for the middle of October. It brings redesigned icons for apps, Settings, Camera, Gallery, and the status bar. Widgets and the search bar have been redesigned to feature transparent details, which is said to add “depth and layering”. The Nothing OS 5.0 updates Gallery with similar transparent details.
title: Nothing OS 5.0 Announced With Over 80 Design Changes, Performance Upgrades: See Release Schedule

description: The iPhone 18 is widely anticipated to be launched next month, alongside Apple’s first-ever foldable iPhone. The latter, dubbed the iPhone Ultra, is expected to be a significant product in the Cupertino-based tech giant’s lineup, marking its foray into the foldable smartphone market. However, an even more significant product could be earmarked for 2027, when Apple celebrates 20th anniversary of the iPhone. Renders of the purported handset have now surfaced, providing an early look at the changes expected with the 20th anniversary iPhone.
title: Apple’s 20th Anniversary iPhone May Feature a Curved Display, New Camera Design, Leaked Renders Suggest

description: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra price in India has officially been reduced. The company updated its online store to confirm. The new starting price is currently live on Flipkart and the Samsung India online store. The smartphone maker has reduced the prices of the 12GB + 256GB and 12GB + 512GB RAM and storage configurations. After the revision, the price of the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra starts at Rs. 1,24,999 in India for the base 256GB model. Apart from the direct price cut of Rs. 15,000, Flipkart is offering an instant cashback of Rs. 4,000 with Flipkart Axis and Flipkart SBI credit cards on the purchase of the Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra.
title: Samsung Galaxy S26 Ultra Price in India Drops By Rs. 15,000 Months After Launch: See New Prices

description: Xiaomi has introduced the Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 and Mijia Smart Air Purifier 4 Compact in India, alongside the return of the Xiaomi Smart Air Purifier 4 Lite. The Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6 supports spaces up to 940 sq ft, while the 4 Compact targets rooms of 400+ sq ft. The three models are priced at Rs. 19,999, Rs. 7,999 and Rs. 12,999, respectively, and will go on sale from September 2 through multiple online and offline channels.
title: Xiaomi's Mijia Smart Air Purifier 6, 4 Compact Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Boltt Ace 5G has been launched in India, along with the new Boltt Evo. Two new smartphones arrive in the country as the first handset offerings from Fire-Boltt's new sub-brand. The new Boltt phones will go on sale in India on September 1 via Flipkart. The Boltt Ace 5G is offered in Arctic White, Burgundy Bliss, Forest Green, Lavender Bloom, Midnight Black, and Sky Blue colour options. On the other hand, the Boltt Evo will be available for purchase in Arctic White, Berry Red, Lavender Bloom, Midnight Black, and Sky Blue colourways. The two phones are powered by Unisoc chipsets, along with a 6,000mAh battery and a dual rear camera unit.
title: Boltt Ace 5G and Boltt Evo Launched in India With 6,000mAh Battery, 6.79-Inch HD+ Display: Price, Specifications

description: CD Projekt Red has finally confirmed a release window for The Witcher 4. The next saga in the Witcher franchise is targeting launch in 2028. The game's release date has not been confirmed yet. CDPR said The Witcher 4 won't be present at Gamescom, where it show the first look at The Witcher 3's Songs of the Past expansion.
title: The Witcher 4 Is Targeting Launch in 2028, CD Projekt Red Confirms

description: Netflix is reportedly discussing ways to make rival streaming services available through its platform, with Peacock and Fox One among the services under consideration. The company has not decided whether users would subscribe to those services through Netflix or access their content directly in the app. Netflix has already experimented with third-party programming through its TF1 partnership in France. The reported discussions come as Amazon Prime Video, Roku and YouTube pursue similar approaches to bringing multiple streaming services together.
title: Netflix Reportedly in Talks to Bring Rival Streaming Services to Its Platform

description: Bitcoin crossed $80,000 after a strong weekly rally, supported by institutional ETF demand and improved liquidity conditions. Ethereum and major altcoins also gained, while Bitcoin dominance climbed to nearly 59.8 percent. Analysts warned that stretched momentum could lead to profit-taking, with US PCE inflation data and Federal Reserve signals from Jackson Hole likely to influence the next market move.
title: Bitcoin Crosses $80,700 as ETF Demand and Fed Outlook Drive Crypto Rally

description: The Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 from Qualcomm and MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipsets will reportedly fabricated using TSMC's 2nm process. The rumoured octa-core Snapdragon 8 Elite Extreme Gen 6 chipset will reportedly feature three efficiency cores clocked at 3.74GHz, three performance cores clocked at 4.03GHz, and two prime cores, delivering a peak clock speed of 5.01GHz. The SoC is expected to be paired with an Adreno 850 GPU. On the other hand, the unreleased octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset is said to also feature three efficiency cores clocked at 3.1GHz, three performance cores clocked at 4.35GHz, and two prime cores, providing a peak clock speed of 4.55GHz.
title: Snapdragon and MediaTek’s Unreleased Flagship Chipsets Could Be Built Using TSMC’s 2nm Process

description: Plaud’s Note Pro and NotePin S AI note takers have finally arrived in India. The Note Pro is a credit card-sized device that can be attached to the back of a smartphone. The capsule-shaped NotePin S is a wearable that can be worn as a necklace or even as a wristband for recording conversations and summarising meetings using the company's Plaud Intelligence software.
title: Plaud Note Pro and NotePin S AI Note Takers Launched in India: Price, Features

description: Portronics has introduced three reusable LCD writing pads aimed at children, with the Ruffpad Teddy 8.5 and Dino 8.5 offering 8.5-inch screens and the PupX 10 featuring a 10-inch display. The models support writing, drawing and handwriting practice and include one-tap erasing and screen-lock features. Prices start at Rs. 499 for the Dino 8.5, while the Teddy 8.5 and PupX 10 cost Rs. 599 and Rs. 749, respectively. The range is sold through multiple online and offline retailers.
title: Portronics Ruffpad Teddy 8.5, Dino 8.5, PupX 10 With Multicolour LCD Screens Launched in India: Price, Features

description: The GrapheneOS Foundation has announced plans to bring official support for GrapheneOS to select Motorola devices soon. So far, the privacy-focused open-source Android operating system has been limited to Google's Pixel smartphones. But beginning next year, support will be rolled out for a Motorola flagship, before eventually expanding to the company's foldable smartphone lineup. However, the organisation says Motorola's current-generation smartphone hardware falls short of some of its security requirements.
title: GrapheneOS Is Coming to Motorola’s Foldables Next Year; Support for Razr Fold, Razr Ultra Confirmed

description: The Vivo X500 series is officially confirmed to launch in China next month and it will comprise three models. While a company executive did tease major camera upgrades on the next-generation lineup, specifications officially remain under wraps. Ahead of their anticipated debut, one of the handsets has surfaced on a benchmarking site. The listing confirms the upcoming handset's moniker as the Vivo X500 Pro Max, while also revealing some of its key specifications.
title: Vivo X500 Pro Max Reportedly Surfaces on Geekbench With Unannounced MediaTek Chip, 12GB RAM

description: The Poco F9 series has been rumoured to be in development for quite a while now, and we finally have a launch date. The lineup is expected to comprise two models, although their exact monikers currently remain under wraps. The handsets will be launched in the global markets in early September. They are expected to arrive as rebranded versions of the Redmi K100 series models, which are exclusive to China. The Poco F9 series could be powered by the Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: Poco F9 Series Global Launch Set for September 1, Poco F9 Pro, F9 Ultra Confirmed to Debut

description: HP recently launched the OmniPad 12 in India for Rs. 48,999. The tablet is currently on sale in the country via the company’s online store in a single Meteor Silver colourway. It is a well-built tablet bundled with a detachable, full-size QWERTY keyboard, aiming to replace conventional work laptops. It sports a large 12-inch 2K resolution LCD screen, which gets most things right. However, its underpowered chipset pulls down the overall experience.
title: HP OmniPad 12 Review: Can This Tablet Replace Your Work Laptop?
